profiles.runtime: TRT-LLM FP8 H200 TP1 scaled to 4-GPU unit (TP=4 topology assumed)
profiles.prefillSource: Prefill del catalogo hardware. Decode: low≈2× H200 TP1 @ 32768/1024 (519×2, overhead TP), base≈4× @ 8192/1024 (1828×4), high=4× @ 1000/1000 (6868×4). Uno scaling TP perfetto è ottimistico: considera high un limite superiore.
